name: Beauty & Essex
status_note: Official Tao Group page current with hours, menu and holiday seatings. It is a restaurant/lounge behind a pawn-shop front, not a late-night club; closed Mondays.

dress.detail: The official reservations page asks guests to refrain from apparel that is excessively casual; no detailed rules are published.

cover.value: None listed (restaurant/lounge); optional $86/pp set menu, whole table must participate

getting_in.value: Reservations on OpenTable (parties up to 14; 15+ email the venue); 24-hour notice for cancellations

hours.value: Closed Mon; Tue–Wed 5–10pm; Thu 5–11pm; Fri–Sat 5pm–midnight; Sun 5–10pm

subway.value: Delancey St–Essex St (F, J, M, Z), about 2 blocks south, ~3 min walk; station not currently step-free

sources.name: Transit app: Delancey St–Essex St station

skip_if: You want a late night: it closes by 10–11pm most nights and midnight on Fri–Sat, and is closed Mondays.
You're on a budget: OpenTable lists it in the top $$$$ tier and cocktails run about $20 each.
